name: Global Matrix Determinant Sum
description: Replaces the explicit zero-diagonal check of S^T P S with a global sum of determinants of pairwise matrix sums. The chosen base matrix W has the property that det(W^a + W^b) is 1 if a != b, and 4 if a == b. The sum over m edges equals m if and only if all edges have distinct values. This global formulation prevents naive local pruning unless the model symbolically discovers the truth table of the matrix operations, forcing models that rely on surface pattern matching to write unpruned exponential-time searches.
